title: An adaptive localized orthogonal decomposition method for Helmholtz problems
summary: We develop an adaptive localized orthogonal decomposition (ALOD) method for Helmholtz problems with parametrized loads. Under standard resolution, oversampling, and discrete-stability conditions, we establish, to our knowledge, the first wavenumber-robust residual a posteriori error estimate for a Helmholtz LOD discretization. The estimate is two-sided relative to the fine-grid solution and includes a computable bound for the corrector-localization error.
